title: CINA: Climate Issue-Network Analysis Framework
description: An end-to-end LLM → graph → LLM pipeline for climate-negotiation intelligence, retrospectively validated on the COP30 Belém Adaptation Indicators outcome (FCCC/PA/CMA/2025/L.25E). Multi-axis Stage 1 stance extraction (stance + NATO 4-axis policy instruments + 5-frame typology + procedural-authority signals), Stage 2 heterogeneous graph + Leiden + R-GAT analysis with emergent chair-edge attention, Stage 3 graph-grounded briefing generation. Released as a graduate-research preliminary methodology pilot with cross-LLM Krippendorff α = 0.876 / 0.933, validation Spearman ρ = 0.658, contested-issue P@3 = 1.00 (N = 3), and 4 pre-registered COP31 prospective hypotheses.
